Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
The findings indicate a urinary tract infection (UTI) with significant bacteriuria (>100,000 CFU/mL E. coli), pyuria (elevated leukocytes), hematuria, positive nitrites, and proteinuria. The low specific gravity may suggest dilute urine. No casts were observed. Clinical correlation and prompt antimicrobial therapy are recommended.
